text.brief: Sun Yat-sen was in Denver raising money when the Wuchang uprising began in October 1911, and he read of it in a newspaper.
text.record: Sun joined the Chee Kung Tong, a secret society with lodges in American Chinatowns, in Honolulu in 1904 and used its network to raise funds ([University of Hawaii at Manoa: Sun Yat-sen handout (Chinese Studies)](https://manoa.hawaii.edu/chinesestudies/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/SYS-handout.pdf)). Laundrymen, cooks and merchants in American cities paid for much of the revolutionary league's work. The Party merged its Overseas Chinese Affairs Office into the United Front Work Department in 2018 ([Xinhua (Chinese): CPC Central Committee plan to deepen reform of Party and state institutions, March 21, 2018](https://www.xinhuanet.com/politics/2018-03/21/c_1122570517.htm); [Xinhua (English): CPC releases plan on deepening reform of Party and state institutions](https://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-03/21/c_137055471.htm)).
text.reading: The republic grew from a diaspora mesh that no government commanded. The Party runs that same association layer through its United Front today, and the 2018 merger put the whole layer under one department.
text.gapText: Business Architecture. No defender owns the association layer, so a diaspora's own institutions sit open to capture.
text.fix: Support independent community institutions and protect them from coercion, without treating their members as suspects.
